description: FUL-INFRA-001 — the single declaration of Fulcrum role expectations for the inference substrate. Role name -> oMLX model basename (directory name under the node model root). These are two separate namespaces: role expectations are NEVER derived from observed oMLX basenames at runtime (ADR-008). judge and every coder role are forbidden on the Fulcrum path (ADR-008); the laptop is never a Fulcrum node (ADR-007).
